name: QiYi 3x3 (Glow in the Dark)
description: The QiYi 3x3 (Glow in the Dark) is a fun, beginner-friendly 3x3 speed cube that stays visible when the lights go out. Its glow-in-the-dark plastic charges under light and then shines in darkness, making it perfect for night solves, gifts, and display. With a modern 55.5 mm size and an 80 g feel, it’s comfortable for new solvers learning the 3x3 and for seasoned cubers who want a unique practice cube.
features: Solve in the dark: Glow-in-the-dark material makes the cube easy to see during night practice.
Easy glow activation: Charge it under sunlight or room light — UV light works best, but regular light works too.
Comfortable handling: 55.5 mm size balances control and speed for most hands.
Display-worthy look: Glossy finish plus the glow effect makes it a standout cube on a desk or shelf.
Expose the cube to light (sunlight, room light, or UV light).
Turn off the lights and enjoy glowing solves.
